subject: which truecap option fits your next deal?
preheader: free screen or pro workflow—choose by the job.
headline: Choose the smallest TrueCap option that does the job.
body: Use Free when you need a fast first-pass screen: cap rate, cash-on-cash, DSCR, cash flow, a secondary Screening Index, selected-rule fit, and up to 5 saved deals.
Use Free when a first-pass screen is enough, then keep verifying the material assumptions outside the software. The Offer Ceiling is not a recommended offer.

Use Investor Pro when you repeatedly need editing, unlimited saves, Buy Box screening, Offer Ceiling, sensitivity, 10-year cash-flow and equity projections, comparison, and branded reports. Integrated BRRRR and flip lifecycle models are not currently released. Whether the time savings justify it depends on your volume and workflow.
The pricing page is the source of truth for the 21-day no-card evaluation, current prices, immediate-charge billing terms, and any configured campaign offer. Review the checkout total before paying.
